input.query: SELECT channel, count(*) AS observed_tenure_months, sum(avg_margin_eur) AS observed_cumulative_margin_eur, min(cac_eur) AS cac_per_activated_eur_min, max(cac_eur) AS cac_per_activated_eur_max, max(avg_margin_eur) AS highest_monthly_margin_eur FROM agg_unit_economics WHERE channel='paid_social' GROUP BY channel
